fusions.name: Between the Plates
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 28 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Spalled Scales
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. A burst of hardened scales that deals 8 slashing damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Venomous Rebuke
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Overlapping Hide
fusions.desc: Overlapping scales harden you: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, 5% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it, and your dodge chance rises by 4%.
